articles.title: Bureaucratic paralysis chokes medicine supplies in government hospitals
articles.description: Kerala hospitals face acute medicine shortages due to KMSCL's administrative paralysis and re-tendering delays, impacting supplies from paracetamol to cancer drugs, with officials expecting deliveries soon.
